_comment: Stage definitions for the Research Director (/research-pipeline). Read by scripts/orchestrator.py and hooks/orchestrator_guard.py. 'agents' = project Agents that may be dispatched in that stage (an agent may be dispatched in its own stage or any later stage, never earlier). 'min_artifacts' = artifacts that must be registered (and non-empty) before the gate can pass. 'require_name' / 'require_text' are regexes (case-insensitive) that some artifact path / the artifacts' text must match. 'checks' = named mechanical checks run by verify (see scripts/paper_tools.py stage_check): citations_resolved, citations_verified, results_linked, no_open_questions.

stages.name: 问题
stages.gate: 问题与 estimand 是否确定？

stages.name: 文献
stages.gate: 缺口是否真实、文献是否遗漏？

stages.name: 机制
stages.gate: 假说能否由机制推出？法源是否核实？

stages.name: 设计
stages.gate: 识别假设是否可辩护？计划是否冻结？

stages.name: 执行
stages.gate: 是否按计划执行？偏离是否记录？

stages.name: 独立审查
stages.gate: 审查意见是否已完整汇报？

stages.name: 决定
stages.gate: 致命问题是否已解决？接受 / 退回 / 停止

stages.name: 论文大纲
stages.gate: C1：主张清单、结构与引言/文献布局是否确定？

stages.name: 引文
stages.gate: C2：引文表（已核验/待核验）是否可接受？

stages.name: 成稿
stages.gate: C3：主张—证据对照是否准确？

stages.name: 精修
stages.gate: C4：精修结果与剩余问题是否可接受？

stages.name: 终检
stages.gate: C5：投稿前清单（含 AI 使用披露）是否完成？
